title: platformSystemApi on a host code action handler's api sheds the 'action' mark and leaves the runtime seams
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXGvw43spR79ztEvWt

## What

PR #35124 (card #35052) publishes `platformSystemApi(api)` from `@objectstack/objectql`. It returns a system api derived through the symbol-keyed member `ScopedContext#[PLATFORM_SYSTEM_API]`, which sheds the `'action'` app-automation mark and `flowRunId`. The member guards only app-authored hook apis (`if (this.appAuthored) return ScopedContextFacet.sudo.call(this);`).

A host code action handler registered through `engine.registerAction` receives runtime's `buildActionApi` api: `ql.createContext(buildActionExecutionContext(ec))` (`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`), carrying the `'action'` mark and not app-authored. Two consequences:

1. **Mark shed.** `platformSystemApi(ctx.api)` on that api returns a system api with neither the mark nor the run, so its identity-assignment writes (`sys_member`, `sys_user_position`, `sys_user_permission_set`, `sys_invitation`) and its append-only inserts pass as platform writes. `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` rows 1b and 2 say a host code action handler's context carries the mark and is refused those writes.
2. **Seams left behind.** Runtime's `deriveThroughSeam` (`packages/runtime/src/stored-metadata-reader-seam.ts`, the switch near line 410-444 on main) wraps `object`, `sudo`, `withRunAs`, `transaction` and `beginTransaction`; its `default` arm binds any other member, the symbol member included, to the unwrapped target. The derived api comes back outside the stored-metadata read seam (#21454) and the landed-write answer (#28861).

Not a reach gain today: the handler's package registers through `ql` and can already call `ql.createContext({ isSystem: true })`. The engine cannot tell this api from the platform hook api the audit writer holds (both non-app-authored, both carrying an inherited `'action'` mark), so a guard like #35124's needs a new signal. PR #35124's module header in `packages/objectql/src/platform-system-api.ts` now states this gap (contract review 6972571588 F1, closed in prose).

## Routes to decide when picked up

- **A.** Add `[PLATFORM_SYSTEM_API]` to `deriveThroughSeam`'s walk, so the derived api stays seam-wrapped (closes 2, not 1).
- **B.** Give the action door's api a provenance flag that the facet guards on, the way `appAuthored` guards hook apis (closes 1; with A, both).

## Origin

Contract review 6972571588 on PR #35124 (F1, optional follow-up), os-dev report 6974855751 (out of scope finding), L1-a 6974907139.

Re-check (after #35124 merges): `git grep -n "default:" origin/main -- packages/runtime/src/stored-metadata-reader-seam.ts` and `git grep -n "PLATFORM_SYSTEM_API" origin/main -- packages/runtime/src`
